name: AgentVoice
description: AI voice & audio services — real-time voice calls, transcription, and text-to-speech. Pay with crypto credits.

steps: Add this MCP server to your AI system configuration
Use the create_account tool to register and get an API key
Use buy_credits to purchase credits via crypto
Use list_services to see available tiers and pricing
Use initiate_call, transcribe_audio, or text_to_speech to use services
